categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: intelligent manufacturing plus integrated services focused on smart box-type power equipment, and electric vehicle charging networks. The company provides comprehensive power system solutions covering generation, grid, load, storage, and vehicle scenarios, and operates a large-scale EV charging network with manufacturing, operation, and value-added services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-voltage gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), modular prefabricated substation designs, digital and intelligent manufacturing lines, and AI-driven charging network management. It employs digital production lines, flexible assembly, and integrated EPCO (Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Operation) service models. Innovations include high-power liquid-cooled charging modules, automated charging robots, and virtual power plant platforms integrating EVs and distributed energy resources.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include new energy power generation groups, grid companies, railway systems, industrial enterprises, data centers, and new energy vehicle manufacturers. The company serves domestic markets extensively and has a growing international presence in regions such as the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Pacific, targeting sectors like renewable energy, power grids, mining, oil and gas, and data centers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic coverage across provinces and cities. It has expanded internationally to 56 countries and regions, focusing on strategic markets including the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Pacific Rim. It maintains partnerships with global energy leaders and has localized marketing and service systems in overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment and electric vehicle charging supply chains. It manufactures and integrates power equipment, provides EPCO services, and operates charging networks, linking equipment production with energy management and service operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in smart manufacturing, digitalization, and integrated service solutions for power equipment and EV charging networks. R&D focuses on high-voltage modular substations, high-power charging technology, AI-driven energy management, virtual power plants, and battery safety models. It aims to enhance product quality, reduce costs, and expand global market reach while supporting national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of power equipment and EV charging devices, EPCO project contracts, charging service fees, SaaS platform subscriptions, energy management services, and value-added data services. The company also earns income from equipment leasing and financing arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's outdoor box-type power equipment and EV charging network sectors, holding top market shares in new energy power generation and public charging infrastructure. It competes with global energy equipment giants like GE, Siemens, ABB, and Schneider Electric, leveraging technological innovation and integrated service capabilities to maintain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 15.37 billion, a 21.15% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 916.56 million, up 86.62%. It has steadily expanded its asset base to over RMB 25 billion and maintains strong cash flow generation, reflecting robust growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. emphasizes rapid deployment, high integration, digital intelligence, and full lifecycle services in its power equipment solutions, offering customers fast, economical, reliable, and smart products. Its EV charging network provides flexible, safe, and intelligent charging with extensive coverage and advanced AI-driven management, creating a comprehensive energy ecosystem that supports new energy integration and grid stability.
